summary: Backend-only testing of HAAKO post-CORS-fix and cover_image migration to Emergent Object Storage. All 15 pytest cases PASS. Public endpoints (articles, /api/files/*) are accessible without auth; admin endpoints correctly require auth; payload reduced from 2.4MB to ~5KB; CORS at the FastAPI layer correctly returns a specific origin (not '*') with allow_credentials=true.

minor.issue: When hit via https://haako-energy.preview.emergentagent.com, the Cloudflare/preview ingress rewrites Access-Control-Allow-Origin to '*' AND replaces Cache-Control with 'no-store, no-cache, must-revalidate'. The backend itself returns the correct values (verified via localhost:8001). This means: (a) on production haako.online the deployed backend will work correctly because the CORS code is right; (b) the preview URL is technically violating CORS spec (ACAO='*' with ACAC='true') due to edge-proxy override — but this is platform/ingress behavior, not the app code. Browsers may still block fetch on the preview URL because of this — keep in mind for end-to-end UI testing on the preview deployment.

action_items: No backend code changes required — CORS fix and cover_image migration are working correctly.

Heads-up only: the preview URL ingress overrides CORS/Cache-Control headers; if you must validate browser-level CORS on the preview deployment, raise with platform team. Production haako.online should behave correctly since the FastAPI layer is verified compliant.
critical_code_review_comments: /api/files/{path:path} endpoint correctly excludes _id from db.files lookups and returns proper Cache-Control: public, max-age=31536000, immutable (verified at backend).

CORS middleware correctly uses allow_credentials=true with explicit allow_origins list + allow_origin_regex for *.emergent.host / *.emergentagent.com / *.haako.online — no wildcard origin in the FastAPI layer.
Storage init runs lazily via init_storage(); startup hook attempts it and gracefully falls back to lazy init if env var missing — current logs confirm 'Emergent Object Storage initialized'.
Minor: server.py is 598 lines — still within manageable range but approaching the 700-line threshold; consider splitting auth + articles + files into separate routers when adding more features.
test_credentials: Not applicable — admin endpoints were verified only for 401/403 without token (per request).
seed_data_creation: None. Used existing migrated article 'logiciels-statistique' and existing uploaded file 'haako/uploads/migration/aac53472a9bc4e369b4b3d220c446c92.png'.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Note: the slug in the original test request 'haako-energy' does not exist in DB; the actual migrated slug is 'logiciels-statistique' — tests were updated accordingly. Articles in DB: logiciels-statistique (uses /api/files/ cover), hydrogene-vert-afrique-hub-mondial, financement-climatique-afrique, transition-energetique-mauritanie-2024 (last 3 use Unsplash URLs). The preview URL goes through Cloudflare which strips/overrides CORS and Cache-Control headers — always assert these against http://localhost:8001 to validate the backend behavior.
rca_of_the_issue: Initial 5/12 test failures were not actual bugs — they were caused by (1) wrong test fixture slug 'haako-energy' (article doesn't exist; real slug is 'logiciels-statistique'), and (2) the preview URL's Cloudflare edge proxy overriding both Access-Control-Allow-Origin (-> '*') and Cache-Control (-> 'no-store, no-cache, must-revalidate'). After updating tests to (a) use the correct slug and (b) verify CORS/Cache-Control directly against the FastAPI app at localhost:8001 while still validating public-facing behavior (status code, content-type, public no-auth access) via the preview URL, all 15 tests pass. The backend code (server.py CORSMiddleware config + /api/files cache headers) is correct.
